ai_review.summary: Perfect soundboard mix with prominent Phil and a solid ’71 Dead performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for an absolutely perfect soundboard mix, with Phil Lesh’s bass standing out in crystal‑clear separation. Reviewers also note the show as a solid 1971 Dead set, delivering the usual high energy of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review highlights an excellent soundboard recording and a solid performance; with limited data the rating is weighted toward a strong show and flawless mix.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as absolutely perfect, Phil’s bass very prominent, excellent instrument separation.
